spans.s:
m. (-रः)
Uttering a menacing sound, roaring, bellowing.
E.
हुम्, and कार making; also similar compounds, as हुङ्कृति, हुङ्कृत, &c.

Roaring.
E.
हूम्, and कार making.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Uttered or pronounced as an incantation.
n. (-तं)
1 An incantation.
2 The roar or grunt of the wild boar.
3 Any roar.
E.
हुम् a mystical monosyllable, and कृत made.
